meta.title: qareeb — Far from them… still Qareeb
meta.description: Pay your family’s bills in Syria and top up their phones from anywhere in the world, in one tap. Join the waitlist.

p: Qareeb (قريب) is an upcoming mobile app that will let Syrians abroad pay bills and top up mobile balances for their family in Syria. This website is Qareeb’s pre-launch page and waitlist.
If you have any question about this policy or your data, contact us at support@qareeb.info.
When you join the waitlist, we collect only:
items: Your preferred language (detected from the page you used)
Your consent to receive emails from us about the launch
after: We collect nothing else through the form. We do not collect any payment information at this stage.

p: We use your information only to tell you about Qareeb’s launch and to send you important updates about the app.
We do not sell or rent your personal data to anyone.

Your data is stored with trusted service providers that help us manage form submissions and host this website. They process it on our behalf, under appropriate safeguards, and only for the purposes described in this policy.
This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
We keep your data until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it, or until the waitlist is no longer needed — whichever comes first. After that, we delete it.
At any time, you can:
items: Ask for a copy of the data we hold about you
Withdraw your consent to receive emails from us
after: To do any of this, email support@qareeb.info. We will reply within 30 days.

p: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from loss, misuse and unauthorized access. However, no system is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Qareeb and its waitlist are intended only for people aged 18 or over. If you are under 18, please do not join the waitlist.
We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the “Last updated” date at the top of this page.
By using this website, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.
This website is an informational pre-launch page for Qareeb and a waitlist for people who want to hear about the launch.
Joining the waitlist does not create an account and does not create any obligation for you or for us. It does not guarantee access to the app, or any particular features, prices or launch date.
The information on this website — including illustrative examples such as sample amounts and screens — is for general information only. It may change at any time and is not an offer.
The Qareeb name, logo, design and the content of this website belong to Qareeb. You may not copy, reproduce or use them without our written permission, except as allowed by law.
When using this website, you agree not to:
items: Misuse the website or try to disrupt how it works
Submit fake sign-ups or someone else’s details without their permission

p: We work to keep this website accurate and available, but we provide it “as is”, without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, Qareeb is not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be limited by law.
We may update these terms from time to time. When we do, we will change the “Last updated” date at the top of this page. Continuing to use the website means you accept the updated terms.
If you have any question about these terms, contact us at support@qareeb.info.
